- Cake slice (tres leches style, partly eaten): about 80 g, roughly 200 kcal.
- Fruit bowl (apple and nectarine chunks): about 50 g, roughly 30 kcal.
- Main plate (sauce residue): about 25 g, roughly 40 kcal.
- Salad bowl (a few greens): about 5 g, roughly 3 kcal.
- Dressing cup (small amount left): about 8 g, roughly 30 kcal.

Totals come to about 168 g and 303 kcal, which I've rounded.
